subject: Virtual interview loop — availability & accessibility needs
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Alvarez <jordan.alvarez@example.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual interview loop — availability & accessibility needs

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We are excited to move you into the final virtual loop for the Platform Engineer role. Quick items to coordinate so we can finalize the calendar: 

1) Proposed time slots (Pacific):
   - Tue Jun 16, 10:00–12:00 PT
   - Tue Jun 16, 13:30–15:30 PT (if you prefer an afternoon block)

2) Accessibility needs: you noted in your application that you may want live captions and an extra 20-minute buffer between interviews. We can request live captions for the whole loop and insert a 20-minute break between session 2 and 3 — is that sufficient?

3) Platform & interview logistics: the loop will be 4 x 30-minute interviews (engineering, system design, product collaboration, and hiring manager), followed by a 20-minute buffer for any overtime/QA. I'll attach the draft agenda and your resume to this thread.

Please reply with the preferred slot and confirm the accessibility requests. Once you confirm, I'll send the Zoom link and calendar invite with captions enabled.

Attachments: Jordan_Alvarez_Resume.pdf, virtual_loop_agenda_06012.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Virtual interview loop — availability & accessibility needs

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks, I can do Tue Jun 16, 10:00–12:00 PT. Live captions would be very helpful, and the 20-minute buffer is appreciated — please place it between the system design and product collaboration interviews if possible.

One small note: I'm in PDT (same timezone), and I prefer to join from the Zoom desktop client. If the captioning requires a separate link or passcode let me know.

Looking forward to it,
Jordan

Product Engineer | formerly @BrightArc

Team —

Jordan confirmed Tue Jun 16, 10:00–12:00 PT with live captions and a 20-minute buffer between interview 2 and 3. I’ve engaged CaptionNow (cc’d) to provide live captioning for the full session. CaptionNow: please confirm you can caption for the entire two-hour block and that the captions will appear in the Zoom transcript pane (not as a separate app) — Jordan will join via desktop client.

Zoom link (provisional): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210 Passcode: 6rX9vQ
Please do not circulate the recording link outside the panel.

Interviewer prep (short):
- Marcus (Hiring manager): 30m end-of-loop for role fit + culture questions. Please prepare 3 questions about operational priorities.
- Dylan (Systems): 30m focused on distributed KV cache design; consider a small whiteboard prompt.
- Ava (Product): 30m on cross-team collaboration + product tradeoffs.
- Dev (Eng Ops): join first 10m for system reliability questions and remain available for any infra follow-ups.

I've attached the agenda and Jordan's resume. I'll send the calendar invite and the final Zoom (CaptionNow confirmed) once the vendor replies. Also: please review Jordan's resume and flag any prep notes by EOD Friday — I'll consolidate into a one-page interviewer brief.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Technical Recruiter

Subject: Final: Tue Jun 16 virtual loop — calendar invite + day-of notes

Hi all —

Finalized details below and sending the calendar invite (attached .ics). Jordan, captioning is set up through Zoom (CaptionNow confirmed). The Zoom link and passcode are in the calendar invite as well.

Day-of logistics:
- Join the Zoom 5 minutes early; use desktop client.
- Captioning will appear in the Live Transcript panel (enable via "Show Subtitles").
- Break schedule: 10:00–10:30 interview 1; 10:30–11:00 interview 2; 11:00–11:20 BREAK; 11:20–11:50 interview 3; 11:50–12:20 interview 4 + HM wrap-up.
- Interviewers: fill out the scorecard (link in calendar invite) within 24 hours so we can expedite feedback.

Attachments: calendar_invite.ics
Related: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/loop-interviewer-guide-06012

If anything changes, ping me and I’ll update calendars. Appreciate the quick turn on prep notes — I consolidated them into the interviewer guide.

Best,
